slots.embedding_query: Seeking a nutritionally complete, chicken-free dry or wet puppy food suitable for a 3-month-old Golden Retriever with large breed needs. Must be specifically formulated for puppies, with emphasis on supporting growth and development for large breeds, and small enough kibbles for easy chewing at this age. Avoid chicken due to confirmed allergy. Preference for trusted brands such as Nestle when available, but allergen and lifestage appropriateness come first. No rawhide or unsafe inclusions.
slots.bm25_query: (puppy food OR large breed puppy OR growth formula) AND (NOT chicken) AND (NOT rawhide)
slots.rationale: A 3-month-old Golden Retriever requires large breed puppy food with controlled calories and nutrients for healthy growth. Chicken is a known allergen and must be avoided. Recently accepted puppy food subscription, so reaffirm lifestage- and size-appropriateness while strictly enforcing chicken-free. Brand bias for Nestle is a nice-to-have but not mandatory.

slots.embedding_query: Need chicken-free, soft, small-sized training treats appropriate for a 3-month-old Golden Retriever puppy living in an apartment. Treats should be easy to chew and digest, formulated for puppies, and help with training and enrichment. Avoid any rawhide or unsafe ingredients. Chicken must be excluded due to allergy. Lean towards trusted brands like Nestle, but allergy avoidance is required.
slots.bm25_query: (training treats OR puppy treats OR soft treats) AND (NOT chicken) AND (NOT rawhide)
slots.rationale: Training treats are essential for reinforcing positive behaviors in a young, active, apartment-dwelling Golden Retriever puppy. Chicken allergy is a strict exclusion. Small, soft treats are easiest for puppies to eat. Brand preference for Nestle is optional.

slots.embedding_query: Looking for teething chews designed for puppies, tailored to a 3-month-old Golden Retriever with light chew strength and a chicken allergy. Chews should be gentle on developing teeth and gums, safe for young puppies, and completely free of rawhide and chicken-based proteins. Apartment setting means low-odor and minimal mess is a plus. Safety, digestibility, and lifestage fit are musts.
slots.bm25_query: (teething chew OR puppy chew OR gentle chew) AND (NOT chicken) AND (NOT rawhide)
slots.rationale: Teething chews help soothe discomfort in puppies. For a 3-month-old Golden Retriever with light chew strength, chews must be sized and formulated for puppies, gentle, and easy to digest. Chicken-free due to allergy. Apartment living suggests low-odor products. Previous skip of single chew toy suggests cautious selection.

slots.embedding_query: Select dental care products safe and effective for a 3-month-old, large breed puppy with a chicken allergy. Must be VOHC-approved or vet-trusted, suitable for puppy teeth and gentle on gums. No chicken proteins and no rawhide. Dental chews, water additives, or brushes targeting early dental hygiene are appropriate. Apartment life suggests minimizing odor and mess.
slots.bm25_query: (dental chew OR puppy dental OR VOHC) AND (NOT chicken) AND (NOT rawhide)
slots.rationale: Dental hygiene starts early for puppies. This slot targets products for puppy teeth/gums, with strict chicken-free constraint. Lifestage fit, safety, and preference for VOHC seal are essential. Apartment living suggests considering clean, low-odor options.

slots.embedding_query: Find gentle grooming tools and basic puppy hygiene products suitable for a 3-month-old Golden Retriever, focusing on mild shampoo, soft brushes, and grooming wipes that are safe for puppies. No specific allergens noted for topical products, but focus on safety, ease of use, and mild formulas compatible with a puppy’s developing coat and skin. No flea treatments or harsh chemicals.
slots.bm25_query: (puppy grooming OR mild puppy shampoo OR soft puppy brush OR grooming wipes) AND (NOT flea) AND (NOT medicated)
slots.rationale: Regular grooming is key at this early age. Products must be formulated for puppies: mild shampoo, soft brush, safe wipes. No explicit dermal allergies, but avoid harsh chemicals and medicated/flea treatments. Prior acceptance of grooming bundle confirms ongoing need.

slots.embedding_query: Looking for enrichment or interactive dog toys appropriate for a 3-month-old Golden Retriever puppy with light chew strength and high activity levels. Toys should be puppy-safe, gentle, and provide mental stimulation suitable for apartment settings, minimizing noise and mess. Durable enough for a large breed puppy but not designed for aggressive chewers.
slots.bm25_query: (puppy toy OR interactive toy OR enrichment toy) AND (NOT aggressive chewer) AND (NOT rawhide)
slots.rationale: Interactive and enrichment toys are vital for a high-activity, apartment-dwelling puppy, especially at this early age. Should be puppy-appropriate, gentle due to light chew strength, and minimize noise/mess for apartment living. Past skip of single toy suggests selectivity or desire for novelty.
